response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack and web/mobile software developer with strong TDD and craftsmanship background, but has no demonstrated experience in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator hardware, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, or performance optimization for deep-learning workloads at the hardware level. His skill set (TypeScript, Node.js, web frameworks, DLang) and career trajectory are entirely misaligned with the hardware-software co-design and chip architecture focus of this principal-level role.
strengths: Extensive, long-tenured software engineering experience (15+ years) meeting seniority/years bar
Strong low-level systems programming background (DLang, C/C++, async I/O, fibers, high-performance micro-services)
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and public speaking/workshop experience
concerns: No evidence of SoC/IP modeling, chip architecture, or hardware design experience
No AI/deep-learning workload optimization, GPU architecture, or SIMD/MIMD experience
Career focus is web/mobile/backend product engineering, not performance architecture for AI accelerators

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator / GPU / deep-learning optimization background
Strong general software engineering seniority and years of experience
